0022600030.text: The Bucks (1-7, on a four-game losing streak and 5 games back in the Central Division) host the Raptors (4-3, on a one-game winning streak) in the ninth game of Milwaukee's season, an Emirates NBA Cup East Group A matchup. Kam Jones is out for Milwaukee with an ankle injury, while Toronto is without Kawhi Leonard (knee inflammation) and Nate Bittle (foot fracture). The teams have not played yet in the 2026-27 season, and in the 2025-26 season series the Bucks lost 1-3, including a 122-94 loss in Milwaukee on February 22.
